merge_policy: Only events through 8 Mar T24 are visible. INITIAL events of 9-12 Mar, any deliberate RN W/T advertising, K706 Eniwetok strike outcome, and later RO-111 targets remain future.

Indian_Ocean.Eastern_Fleet: INITIAL is GO and underway north from Trincomalee. Branch motive is training/show-of-force plus reassurance after Chittagong loss; route remains west/central Bay to protect Illustrious from needless land-air exposure. Illustrious carries 12 Barracudas + 27 Corsairs.
Indian_Ocean.Japan_awareness: Japan knows the reinforced Eastern Fleet exists at Ceylon but has no fresh 8-Mar sortie track by T24. Surveillance priority rises; no attack or surface intercept is released.
Indian_Ocean.Japan_air: 705 G4M flight element is now K706 and eastbound/east; west-area 705 has only shorter-ranged B5N-centered local capability. Original 331 fighter element becomes S603/202 and starts eastward transfer. Tokai/MAD remains; Ka-go remains local zero.
Indian_Ocean.Japan_submarines: I-162 sinks Fort McCloud on 4 Mar; RO-111 departs Penang 7 Mar for upper-Bay/Calcutta traffic; I-166 remains on patrol; I-37 remains western. None contact INITIAL through 8T24.
Indian_Ocean.Japan_surface: Oyodo group remains a fresh-contact exploitation reserve. Historical SA No.1 remains cancelled. Bay entry alone no longer auto-releases Suzuya/Kumano or other heavy units.

Central_Pacific.First_Mobile_Fleet: Phased southward fuel/training concentration begins as a regeneration/basing decision. Tone/Chikuma remain mobile-fleet scout/screen assets, not Indian-Ocean raiders.
Central_Pacific.K706: Reorganization/eastward concentration continues; no 9-Mar Eniwetok strike result is credited before the clock reaches that event.
Central_Pacific.Eniwetok: US-held; Engebi limited fighter/search staging continues.

next_exact_action: Advance 9-12 Mar. Resolve INITIAL detection as it reaches 13-15N, especially after the RN deliberately breaks W/T silence to advertise its Bay presence; then decide Japanese reconnaissance, submarine cueing, and whether any air/surface strike gate actually opens. Also close K706 Central-Pacific action separately without double-counting west-area aircraft.
